d:
I've created this gallery to share all the example animations of my currently available YCH commissions.
I'm hoping this might be a clearer guide for those that wish to commission me than my other gallery in terms of what animations are available to those that wish to commission me :)
I will update this gallery as new YCHs become available and are updated to my current style, but if you are interested in one of my older animations that isn't shown here, please feel free to ask me about it as I'm happy to update older animations to my current style :D
